title: Bloodstat (staff)
body:
Syntax: bloodstat <player>

Description: Shows a player's hidden Kekkei Genkai state: clan, bloodline (if any), Potential, Talent, awakened status, and mastery (shown as a fraction and percent of that player's own Potential, plus whether they meet BOTH conditions a future stage-2 awakening quest would require -- 90+ raw Potential AND fully-maxed mastery) -- plus, for a Sharingan specifically, tomoe count, active state, Mangekyo status, and both assigned eye techniques. Never shown to the player themselves -- see 'bloodset' to edit these values. The same information appears at the end of 'mstat <player>' for an administrator (or higher).

&D(Staff only -- requires administrator access or higher.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
